description: Committee recommends one-way protected bike lanes for Victoria Avenue.
Project would remove on-street parking, add sidewalks.
Construction costs $3.64 million; snow removal increases annually.

chips.text: Councillor Pearce questioned the 'if we build it, they will come' mentality for bike lane usage.
Taxpayers would fund an annual snow removal increase of $187,000.
No data exists on winter bike traffic for this specific Victoria Avenue segment.
Councillor Pearce opposed due to lack of usage data and high snow removal costs.
Staff will provide information on how other cities fund active transportation projects.

description: Committee recommends new limited residential parking zone in Nutana East.
New zone responds to two resident petitions.
The zone costs $4,700 from existing budget.
City Solicitor to amend parking bylaw.

chips.text: Staff confirmed permit fee increases could achieve cost recovery for parking zones.
Residents in three Nutana East blocks will be affected by new parking rules.
A broader review of the residential parking program will be completed by fall 2026.
